text.tspan: Chapter 4 (b) continued: map -> ranking morph, and the ranking view
Clicking a state turns the map into a ranked bar chart; each state stays the same object, so the eye can follow it. Back / Esc / chips reverse it.
shapes fade (0-340 ms); a box the size of each
state grows into its bar slot (0-750 ms)
Reverse (Back to map / Esc / Map chip): bars shrink back into the state boxes, shapes fade in. Reduced motion: instant switch.
Bar length = admissions per 100,000, highest first · dashed
line = Australia · colour = same 5 classes as the map
How to use: Click a bar (or Enter) to show its trend;
← Back to map or Esc returns to the map.
Click / Enter on a state = select it
Each state is ONE group: its shape
fades while a box from the state's
"← Back to map" only in this view;
Esc and the Map chip do the same;
focus goes back to the state
Selected bar: ink outline, bold value;
Legend and hint change with the
Click another bar: only the trend
